title: Hostel curfew and late entry
scope: Hostel curfew rules for college residents, with late-entry permission that needs a guardian's consent and the warden's decision, and penalties that escalate with repeated late returns.

terms.setting: a simulated term in a college hostel
terms.finding_check_failed: Repeated late returns escalate to disciplinary action
terms.finding_pending_at_check: Late-entry backlog leaves residents facing curfew penalties
terms.finding_near_threshold: A resident ends the term one late return from disciplinary action

example_input.text: Residents must return to the hostel by 10 pm. Late entry needs prior permission from the warden, with the guardian's consent. Repeated late returns lead to a warning, then the guardian is informed, then disciplinary action.
example_input.purpose: Keep residents safe at night, make the hostel accountable to families and keep late entry predictable for security.
example_input.environment: One college hostel over a term of weekday nights. Residents include a student with an evening internship, a research student whose lab work runs late, an athlete who trains in the evening, a student whose family lives in the city, a first-year student new to the city and a student who volunteers at a night shelter. A guardian speaks for the families, a warden decides late-entry requests, security records returns at the gate and a discipline committee applies the penalties. Traffic and lab work sometimes make residents late, and the warden is sometimes away.

parameters.name: curfew_time

parameters.name: warning_at

parameters.description: late returns in the term after which the guardian is informed
parameters.sentence: {value} late returns: the guardian is informed

parameters.name: request_timing
parameters.description: when a late-entry request can be filed

sentences.in_advance: Late entry must be requested before the night; a night already recorded can't be covered.
sentences.after_missed: Late entry can be asked for only after the late return has been recorded.

parameters.name: partial_at_submit
parameters.description: whether a request that lists some nights it can't cover keeps the valid ones

sentences.true: A request that lists some nights it can't cover keeps the ones it can.
sentences.false: A request that lists any night it can't cover is refused whole.

parameters.name: partial_at_decide
parameters.description: whether the warden can approve some nights of a request

sentences.true: The warden can approve some nights of a request and refuse the rest.
sentences.false: The warden approves or refuses each request whole.

parameters.name: excused_counting
parameters.description: whether a night an approved late-entry request covers leaves the late-return count (remove) or counts as back on time (count_as_met); keep remove unless the policy says excused nights count as on time
